description: Check one asset of the iDos Games video studio (actor, set, prop or music — e.g. the answer of the platform MCP's generate_asset, or one you wrote) against the asset contract the studio itself uses: ref, style, title and tags, and the body — a voxel CharacterSpec, a 2D rig recipe (parts, colours, its own SVG art), a cut-out picture, a scene's anchors and camera shots, https addresses. Returns ok and the issues (error = the studio will drop the asset, warning = it works but the AI director will hardly pick it). Free, offline.
name: validate_asset
title: Validate a video asset
